intro: Education, homelab, IoT, and maker sectors were the primary targets in a series of seven Linux-focused incidents reported between April 12 and April 30, 2026. Threat actors Harvester, Payouts King, and The Gentlemen were observed, with the high-severity vulnerability CVE-2026-31431 (CVSS 7.8) featuring prominently. The activity, which included four high-severity reports, one medium, and two informational, affected regions globally and in South Asia.
